name: Synkrift
summary:
Synkrift is a competitive rhythm game for guitar controllers, built around precise timing and skill-based ranking. Every hit is judged in milliseconds, and every play counts toward Clout, a ranking that rewards accuracy and long unbroken combos, with separate standings for guitar and bass.

Push your scores further with mods like Distortion, Blackout and Acoustic, climb the global leaderboards, and study the best runs on every song through replays. Compete in online rooms of up to eight players or go head-to-head in local split-screen. Synkrift plays charts in common community formats and supports guitar controllers, gamepads and keyboard.

Made in Quebec, fully playable in English and French.
